run_order.description: Load this lane's DTE options plan from the API.
Load strategy/safety (options_enabled, min_option_dte, max_option_dte, max_option_debit_usd), lane turn, and this lane's simulated_portfolio.
Verify daily/monthly and per-run-type budget before proceeding.
Verify no critical intervention triggers before proceeding.
Call get_accounts first. Read paper book from context.simulated_portfolio only. Quote SPY/QQQ/VIXY plus open underlyings and the news/reddit shortlist.
Import Robinhood equity orders for reconciliation. Never place live equity or option orders.
Load quotes, indices, volatility proxy, movers, and freshness checklist.
Optional unless this lane's scoring rules require Reddit as the name source.
Read ranked ticker mentions when this lane uses Reddit to find underlyings.
Read stored news, earnings, and macro. Required as the name source on the news lane; confirmation elsewhere.

For shortlisted underlyings: get_option_chains, instruments, quotes. Use only the expiry that matches safety min_option_dte/max_option_dte (0=today ET, 1=next session, Friday 1DTE=Monday). Import OPT:UNDERLYING:YYYY-MM-DD:STRIKE:C|P marks. If quotes 403, do not open.
Load memory for open underlyings and names you will trade or skip.

Manage open paper option lots first. New risk is long debit calls/puts only (no CSP, no covered call, no new equity). Expiry must match this lane's DTE window. Prefer 1 contract. Sitting in cash is allowed.
review_option_order is optional. Never place_option_order or place_equity_order.
Confirm DTE window, name source for this lane, option fields, no live place, paper book ≠ live RH, lots managed.
POST run with option_right/strike/expiry/contracts/fill_price, equity and OPT: quotes, usage, errors.

scoring_rules_extra.rule: Paper-only. Use simulated_option_buy / simulated_option_sell. Do not use simulated_option_write or simulated_option_cover on these DTE lanes. Never place_option_order, place_equity_order, or live buy/sell.

New option opens must satisfy safety.min_option_dte and safety.max_option_dte measured in session days (America/New_York). 0 = expiry today. 1 = next session (Friday → Monday). Do not open weeklies or monthlies on these lanes.
Only long calls/puts. Debit = premium*100*contracts must fit max_option_debit_usd / max_order_usd. Prefer 1 contract. No CSPs, no covered calls, no naked shorts.
Do not simulated_buy / add equity. Flatten existing option lots with simulated_option_sell only. Skip names with no fillable DTE quote.
Option decisions use symbol=underlying (allowed_symbols) plus option_right, strike, expiry (YYYY-MM-DD), contracts, fill_price (premium per share). Import OPT:SPY:2026-08-15:560:C marks.
Only manage context.simulated_portfolio for this lane. Do not hold/trim other-lane or live RH lots.
Call get_accounts first; pass account_number on MCP portfolio/order/option calls.
Every run reviews open option lots. Close 0DTE same day rather than letting them expire unattended. Sitting in cash is allowed.
Skip wide spreads and missing bid/ask. If the chain has no contract in this lane's DTE window, skip — do not substitute a weekly.

required_inputs_extra.name: option_chain_research
required_inputs_extra.description: Listed chain and marks for the DTE expiry only.

data_sources_extra.name: robinhood_options_mcp
data_sources_extra.description: Read and review listed options. place_option_order is forbidden.

stop_conditions_extra.description: If DTE quotes cannot be loaded, manage existing lots only; do not open new options.
If US cash session is closed or option quotes are unavailable, do not open 0DTE/1DTE.
